The biggest offender explicitly [waits 11 seconds](/Users/sean/Source/SpecStory/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/providers/piagent/watcher_test.go:675) to prove shutdown doesn’t abandon a save after ten seconds. It was added in `f018f05`, the September 17 Pi lifecycle improvements.

The reconciliation test waits for the real two-second production timer. Several others wait 300–1,000 ms to assert that nothing happens. These tests run sequentially, so the waits accumulate.

We can preserve the coverage while removing most of that cost: test shutdown ordering with channels and virtual time, drive reconciliation explicitly, and keep a small number of real filesystem integration tests. Simply shortening the waits would weaken the tests and invite more flakes.
